'''Flash-cloth''' was a type of fabric designed to burn away instantly when exposed to fire. It was an invaluable tool for intelligence operatives who needed to perform rapid costume changes.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Wraith Squadron]] members [[Bhindi Drayson]], [[Jesmin Tainer]], and [[Turman Durra]], used them in their clothing.<ref name="MK" />
